title: Sound-Reactive Sculpture with Scoring
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D sound-reactive sculpture scene using Three.js with a built-in scoring system. The entire application should be in a single HTML file. ## Scene Setup - Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 15) looking at the origin. - Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and two point lights: one at (10, 10, 10) colored #ff6644 and one at (-10, 5, -10) colored #4466ff. - Background color: #0a0a1a (dark navy). - Add OrbitControls for camera interaction. ## The Sculpture - Create a central sculpture made of 64 vertical pillars (8x8 grid) arranged in a circular pattern around the origin, radius 4. - Each pillar is a BoxGeometry(0.3, 1, 0.3) with MeshStandardMaterial using metalness 0.7 and roughness 0.3. - Pillars should have initial color #22aaff. - Above the pillars, place a large rotating IcosahedronGeometry(1.5, 2) at y=7 with wireframe material, color #ff44aa. It rotates at 0.5 rad/s around Y axis. ## Audio Simulation (no real audio needed) - Since we can't use real microphone, simulate audio reactivity with a built-in frequency generator. - Maintain an array `frequencyData` of 64 float values (0-1 range). - Each animation frame, update frequencyData using: `frequencyData[i] = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * (1 + i * 0.1) + i * 0.5)` where time is elapsed seconds. - Each pillar's Y-scale should be set to `1 + frequencyData[i] * 4` (so range 1 to 5). - Each pillar's color should interpolate from blue (#2244ff) at value 0 to red (#ff4422) at value 1 based on its frequencyData value. - The icosahedron's scale should pulse based on the average of all frequencyData values: `scale = 1 + avgFrequency * 0.5`. ## Beat Detection & Scoring - Track the average frequency. When the average crosses above 0.7 (rising edge), register a 'beat'. - Maintain a beat counter. - When a beat is detected, briefly flash all pillars white for 100ms, then return to normal coloring. - The scoring system: player can press SPACEBAR during a beat flash window (within 200ms of beat detection) to score points. Each successful hit adds 10 points. Missing gives 0. Pressing SPACE outside a beat window subtracts 5 points (minimum score 0). ## Frequency Mode Toggle - Pressing keys 1, 2, 3 changes the frequency pattern mode: - Mode 1 (default): sine wave pattern as described above. - Mode 2: `frequencyData[i] = Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 2 + i * 0.3)) * Math.abs(Math.cos(time * 0.5))` - Mode 3: `frequencyData[i] = (Math.sin(time * 3 + i) > 0) ? 1.0 : 0.0` (square wave) ## Particle Burst - On each beat detection, spawn 30 small sphere particles (radius 0.05) at random positions near the sculpture center (within radius 2, y between 2-6). - Particles should fly outward with random velocity and fade out over 1 second, then be removed. - Track total particles spawned. ## Pause/Resume - Pressing 'P' toggles pause. When paused, animation stops, frequencyData freezes, no beats detected. ## HUD / DOM Elements - Create a HUD overlay with: - Score display: `
Score: 0
` top-right. - Beat counter: `
Beats: 0
` below score. - Mode indicator: `
Mode: 1
` top-left. - Combo display: `
Combo: 0
` below mode. - Pause indicator: `
PAUSED
` center screen. - A reset button: `` bottom-center. - Style HUD text as white, font-family monospace, font-size 20px. ## Combo System - Track consecutive successful SPACE hits. Each consecutive hit increases combo by 1. - Score for a hit = 10 * combo multiplier (combo value, minimum 1). - Missing a beat (not pressing space during beat window) resets combo to 0. - Pressing SPACE outside beat window resets combo to 0. ## Reset Button - Clicking the reset button resets: score to 0, beats to 0, combo to 0, totalParticlesSpawned to 0, mode to 1, paused to false. ## State Management - Expose `window.__3D_STATE__` with these fields updated every frame: - `score` (number): current score - `beats` (number): total beats detected - `combo` (number): current combo - `mode` (number): current frequency mode (1, 2, or 3) - `paused` (boolean): whether paused - `avgFrequency` (number): current average of frequencyData (0-1) - `pillarCount` (number): should be 64 - `icosahedronScale` (number): current scale of the icosahedron - `totalParticlesSpawned` (number): cumulative particles spawned - `inBeatWindow` (boolean): whether currently in a beat flash window - `elapsedTime` (number): total unpaused elapsed time in seconds - `maxPillarScale` (number): the maximum Y-scale among all pillars currently - `minPillarScale` (number): the minimum Y-scale among all pillars currently Ensure all numerical state values are never NaN or undefined. Initialize window.__3D_STATE__ before the first frame.
physics_constraints: Pillar Y-scale must always be in range [1, 5]. Frequency data values must be in [0, 1]. Score must never go below 0. Icosahedron scale must be in range [1, 1.5]. Particles must be removed after 1 second lifetime. Combo resets on miss or bad press.
